info.description:
# Hospital Referral Hub API
A national‑scale hospital referral management platform that digitises the entire patient‑transfer workflow, from initial doctor referral to final clinical outcome. All actions are governed by strict role‑based access controls and clinical governance rules.

---
## Referral Lifecycle
DRAFT → SUBMITTED → (Liaison) UNDER_LIAISON_REVIEW → FORWARDED
↘ REJECTED_BY_LIAISON
FORWARDED → (Specialist) UNDER_SPECIALIST_REVIEW → ACCEPTED / REJECTED_BY_SPECIALIST
ACCEPTED → SCHEDULED → ASSIGNED → COMPLETED
↘ MISSED / RESCHEDULED / DECEASED

---
## Visibility Rules

| Status | Visible To |
|----------------------|-----------|
| DRAFT / NEED_REVISION | Referring Doctor only |
| SUBMITTED … FORWARDED | Liaison of the sender hospital |
| FORWARDED … COMPLETED | Specialists of the target hospital |
| ACCEPTED … SCHEDULED | Receptionists of the target hospital |
| All statuses | System Admins (global); MoH Analysts (aggregated dashboards, no raw clinical data) |

---
## Critical Business Rules

- **ML Triage Gate**: On submit, the backend calls the ML service (`POST /score`) asynchronously. A referral cannot be accepted while `ml_status` is PENDING, or without a severity score (from ML or manual `POST /specialist/referrals/{id}/triage-severity`).
- **Duplicate Prevention**: A patient may not have more than one active referral (status not COMPLETED, CANCELLED, REJECTED_*, DECEASED) to the same target department. The API returns 409 Conflict.
- **Walk‑in Restriction**: Walk‑ins can only be registered for referrals in ACCEPTED or SCHEDULED status.
- **Emergency Scheduling**: Bypasses buffer days and allows overbooking up to `overbook_limit`. Requires critical condition or explicit justification.
- **Deceased Outcome**: Recording a deceased outcome sets the referral to DECEASED, soft‑archives it (`is_archived=true`), and cancels any pending appointments.
- **Cancel After Send**: A doctor may cancel a referral after sending (REJECTED_AFTER_SEND) only if it has not been accepted yet.

For detailed per‑endpoint rules, see the individual endpoint descriptions below.

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated and searchable list of active users that the authenticated caller is legally authorized to chat with based on role visual boundaries, active access grants, and clinical referral relationships.

### Contact Search Modes:

#### 1. Same-Hospital Mode (Without `referral_id`)
Returns colleagues working at the **same hospital** as the caller:
- **Self-Exclusion:** The caller is never included in the contact list.
- **Specialist Visibility:** Specialists can only see referring doctors to whom they have **active access** (via accepted referrals or explicit access grants).
- **Liaison Officer / Receptionist / Dept Head:** Follow standard hospital-wide visual scopes.
- **Admin & Super-Admin:** Standard administrative and super-admin visual bounds.
- **System Constraints:** Excludes `MOH_ANALYST` completely and excludes `SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN` (unless the caller themselves is a super-admin).

#### 2. Cross-Hospital Mode (With `referral_id`)
Returns eligible clinical contacts at the **opposite hospital** involved in that specific referral context:
- **Visually Scoped Roles:** Limit eligible chat contacts to:
- The referring doctor who created/managed the referral.
- Liaison officers at the target hospital.
- Specialists with active access or assignment to the referral.
- The target department head and the target hospital administrator.
- **Access Gate:** The caller must have permission to access the referral to use this mode.

### Filtering & Search Options:
- **`search`:** Filter users dynamically by first name, middle name, or last name.
- **`role`:** Limit contacts to a specific user role (e.g., `RECEIVING_SPECIALIST`, `REFERRING_DOCTOR`).

### System Constraints:
- `MOH_ANALYST` users are completely barred from using or being returned by this endpoint.

parameters.name: referral_id

parameters.description: Filter by specific user role (e.g., REFERRING_DOCTOR)
parameters.name: role

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all active direct and referral-scoped chat channels involving the authenticated user.

### Features & Fields:
- Shows the latest message preview, unread message count for the current user, and other participant metadata.
- **`is_read_only` (bool):** Set to `true` if the channel is referral-scoped and has reached a terminal state.
- **`is_disabled` (bool):** Set to `true` if an administrator has locked the channel.

### Roles:
- Accessible by all authenticated roles except `MOH_ANALYST`.

parameters.description: Filter by conversation type: all (default), direct (no referral), referral (scoped to a referral)
parameters.name: type

delete.description:
Administratively soft-delete a chat conversation, hiding it from participants while preserving GORM DB records for clinical auditing.

### Role & Boundary Security:
- **System Super Admin:** Global permission to soft-delete any conversation.
- **Hospital Admin:** Authorized **only** for conversations involving their hospital's staff or active referrals.
- **Other Roles:** Rejected with `403 Forbidden`.
- **Audit Trail:** Registers a system audit log capturing the deletion event.

403.description: Unauthorized boundary violation, or non-admin role attempt

put.description:
Administratively lock or unlock a chat channel. Locking a channel (`is_disabled = true`) prevents any further message sending while maintaining read history access.

### Role & Boundary Security:
- **System Super Admin:** Authorized to lock/unlock any conversation globally without restriction.
- **Hospital Admin:** Authorized to lock/unlock conversations **only** if they involve a participant or a referral associated with their hospital. Access from outside this boundary is rejected.
- **Other Roles:** Rejected with `403 Forbidden`.
- **Audit Logging:** Triggers an immutable system audit log entry capturing the change state and reason.

parameters.description: Lock state toggle (`is_disabled`) and mandatory action justification reason
parameters.name: request

400.description: Invalid conversation ID, or missing required justification reason

403.description: Unauthorized admin boundary violation, or non-admin role attempt

500.description: Internal update or audit logging failure

get.description:
Retrieve the message logs for a conversation. If conversation ID is not provided, the system automatically resolves or creates the unique channel using `other_user_id` and optional `referral_id`.

### Security & Administrative Auditing (Spying):
- **Normal Participants:** Allowed to view conversations they are registered members of.
- **Hospital Admins:** Authorized to view/audit message history if the chat involves staff of their hospital or a referral linked to their hospital.
- **System Super Admins:** Unrestricted access to view any conversation globally.
- **Other Roles:** Third-party access is rejected with `403 Forbidden`.

### Auto-Read side-effect:
- Querying messages automatically marks all unread messages in that channel as read for the calling user, updating badge states.

parameters.name: conversation_id

parameters.description: Recipient UUID to resolve direct or referral channel
parameters.name: other_user_id

parameters.description: Referral UUID to scope the conversation search
parameters.name: referral_id

403.description: Unauthorized: Boundary check violation or non-participant access

post.description:
Send a real-time message to another user, either as a direct peer-to-peer message or scoped to a specific clinical referral context.

### Security & Role Authorization Matrix:
- **Allowed Roles:** `SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN`, `HOSPITAL_ADMIN`, `REFERRING_DOCTOR`, `RECEIVING_SPECIALIST`, `LIAISON_OFFICER`, `RECEPTIONIST`, `DEPT_HEAD`.
- **Barred Roles:** `MOH_ANALYST` is strictly forbidden from participating in or receiving chat messages.
- **Receptionist Boundaries:** Receptionists cannot initiate peer chats, and can only receive messages from clinical staff (Doctors/Specialists) inside their own hospital.

### Scoped/Referral Chat Restrictions:
- **Access Control:** If `referral_id` is supplied, both sender and receiver must be connected to the referral (creator, treating/consulting doctor, department head, liaison, or user with active access grant).
- **Terminal States (Read-Only):** The chat room becomes strictly read-only if the referral status is terminal (`COMPLETED`, `DECEASED`, `CANCELLED`, `REJECTED_BY_LIAISON`, `REJECTED_BY_SPECIALIST`, `REJECTED_AFTER_SEND`, `REDIRECTED`).

### Direct (Non-Referral) Peer Chat Initiation:
- **Referring Doctor:** Can initiate with own hospital colleagues, liaison officer at a hospital with active referral, or specialists with active access/accepted referrals.
- **Liaison Officer:** Can initiate with referring doctors of active referrals, or specialists if a network route exists between their hospitals.
- **Receiving Specialist:** Can only initiate if they have active access to the doctor's referrals.
- **Hospital Admin:** Can only initiate with staff of their own hospital.

### Prerequisites:
- Receiver account must be active and not soft-deleted.
- Content must be non-empty and between 1 and 5000 characters.
- Sender and receiver must not be the same user.
- Conversation must not be administrative-locked.

parameters.description: Message details including receiver, optional referral context, and content text
parameters.name: message

400.description: Invalid parameters, empty content, content > 5000 chars, self-send, or inactive recipient

403.description: Unauthorized role, multi-hospital boundary violation, terminal referral (read-only), or admin locked

post.description:

- Proceeds successfully even if the conversation is referral-scoped terminal (read-only) or administratively locked (disabled) so that users can clear their badges.

post.description:
Create a referral in DRAFT or SUBMITTED state and upload attachment files in a single synchronous call.

### Request format: multipart/form-data
- **referral**: JSON string matching the `CreateReferralRequest` schema. Example:
```json
{
"accompanying_person_name": "Sarah Kebede",
"accompanying_person_phone": "+251922334455",
"clinical_summary": "Patient complains of severe chest pain for 2 hours",
"condition_at_referral": "UNSTABLE",
"diagnoses": [
{
"diagnosis_certainty": "SUSPECTED",
"icd_code": "J18.9",
"is_primary": true
}
],
"emergency_detail": {
"emergency_justification": "Patient requires immediate intubation and bypass surgery"
},
"investigation_results": "ECG shows ST elevation",
"liaison_officer_id": "d1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
"medication_on_transfer": "IV Nitroglycerin",
"mode_of_transport": "AMBULANCE",
"patient_history": "Hypertension diagnosed 5 years ago",
"patient_id": "e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
"physical_examination_findings": "BP 180/110, HR 105",
"reason_for_referral_category": "EMERGENCY",
"reason_of_referral": "Requires immediate cardiological intervention",
"status": "SUBMITTED",
"target_dept_id": "b5000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005",
"target_hospital_id": "a3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003",
"treatment_given_before_referral": "Aspirin 300mg",
"vitals": {
"diastolic_bp": 200,
"gcs_score": 15,
"heart_rate": 300,
"respiratory_rate": 60,
"sp_o2": 100,
"systolic_bp": 300,
"temperature": 45
}
}
```
- **attachments**: One or more files (optional).
- **attachment_category**: Category for all attachments (default: GENERAL_CLINICAL).

**Validation:**
- DICOM/PDF files are verified for metadata.
- If a file is rejected during a SUBMITTED request, the referral moves to NEED_REVISION.

**Roles:** REFERRING_DOCTOR

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of in-app notifications targeting the current authenticated user.

### Query Options & Extensive Filters:
- **`limit`**: Controls size of paginated array (sanitized to safe positive default of 20).
- **`page`**: Page number to load (sanitized to safe positive default of 1).
- **`event_type`**: Filter by event trigger keys (e.g. `STAFF_ADDED`, `REFERRAL_SUBMITTED`, `CLINICAL_UPDATE_ADDED`, `APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULED`, `PATIENT_DECEASED`, `BATCH_SCHEDULE_COMPLETED`).
- **`is_read`**: Filter by read (`true`) or unread (`false`) state.
- **`referral_id`**: Scopes search to notifications belonging to a specific clinical referral context.
- **`start_date` / `end_date`**: Range bounds targeting the creation timestamp (format: `YYYY-MM-DD`). End date is automatically extended to 23:59:59 of that day.
- **`search`**: Full-text fuzzy search matched against the notification title or description message.

parameters.description: Filter by exact system event type string
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.description: Fuzzy text search in title and message text
parameters.name: search

401.description: Unauthorized: Invalid or expired session token

get.description: Retrieve the current total count of unread notifications targeting the authenticated user.

post.description:
Mark a specific in-app notification as read for the authenticated user.

### Ownership Verification:
- The system validates that the target notification record belongs to the calling user (`user_id = userID`).
- Attempts to mark another user's notification as read are rejected.

parameters.description: Notification UUID to mark as read
parameters.name: id

- **category**: Category for the attachment (e.g., RADIOLOGY, LAB_REPORT, DICOM_XRAY). Defaults to GENERAL_CLINICAL.

**Verification:** DICOM and PDF files are checked for valid metadata.

**Prerequisites:** Referral must be in DRAFT or NEED_REVISION status.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 Invalid ID or file too large (> 20MB)
- 403 Forbidden (not the creator or invalid status)

get.description:
Retrieve detailed profile of a user with nuanced visibility rules.
**Roles:** All authenticated roles (with visibility rules).
**Visibility Rules:**
- System Admins: Can view any profile.
- Clinical roles: Can view each other across hospitals (for referrals).
- Clinical roles: Cannot view SystemAdmins or Receptionists from other hospitals.
- Receptionists: Can ONLY view users within their own hospital.
- MOH Analysts: Cannot view any user except their own.
**Common Errors:**
- 403 visibility violation
- 404 Not Found
